archimate:Goal.name: Comprehensive Needs Assessment : Systematic evaluation of patient's complete health status, risks, and care requirements
archimate:Goal.documentation:
The "Comprehensive Needs Assessment" goal is a patient-centered quality objective focused on systematically identifying and evaluating a patient's complete physical, mental, social, and environmental health requirements during their entry into a care program.
Its purpose is to move beyond isolated clinical diagnoses to uncover the underlying social determinants of health, functional limitations, and personal goals that must be addressed to design an effective, personalized care plan.
Example: A home health agency achieves this goal by conducting a standardized intake assessment that evaluates not only a patient's post-surgical wound care needs, but also their mobility risks, nutritional access, and cognitive support systems at home.
